entry.title: [Beta] We built an API for creating and simulating AI personas and are looking for developers to give us feedback.
entry.summary: Hi everyone, My co-founder and I are looking for beta testers for our new API, Psyloom. It's a tool that lets you create and interact with psychologically-grounded digital personas. You describe a personality in free-form text, and our API builds a stable, interactive model of it. You can then have dialogues with this persona, test its reactions, and simulate behaviors. We built this because we found that standard LLMs, while powerful, lack a stable, underlying model of personality. Their "persona" is an emergent effect of a prompt, which makes them inconsistent for serious testing. Psyloom aims to solve this by providing a consistent psychological engine. The private beta is free. We're not selling anything. We're just looking for honest feedback from other builders on the API, the documentation, and potential use cases. You can see the demo and sign up here: https://psyloom.com/ Full API docs are here: https://github.com/valkoivo/psyloom Thanks for taking a look. We'll be here to answer any questions. – Pavel
